verdict.rationale: Asana's MCP server explicitly supports generating reports and summaries from Asana data via natural language, and AI Teammates/Dash are positioned as AI agents working within workflows with shared memory, which could plausibly draft status updates. However, no evidence specifically documents an AI feature that drafts a project/initiative 'status update' object from recent activity (Asana has a native Status Update feature but no citation shows AI drafting it). missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI drafting native Asana status updates from recent activity, hands-on/independent confirmation of this specific workflow, detail on how recent activity is synthesized into a status update.
